Calculate Stack Totals

Source: R/plot.R
dot-calculate_stack_totals.Rd

Internal function to calculate totals for stack components.

Usage

.calculate_stack_totals(data, x_axis_from, panel_var)

Arguments

data

Data frame containing stack components.

x_axis_from

Column for x-axis categories.

panel_var

Column for panel facets.

Value

Data frame with calculated totals.
